name: blood-sweat-and-code
description: A cheerful pastel-purple coding companion for ARMY. Track sweat (keystrokes), blood (bugs squashed) and code (lines), with pixel hearts, a 7 burst, BTS sounds, and easter eggs. Fan-made by @tipandtale. Not affiliated with HYBE or BTS.

bloodSweatCode.blips.description: Show 'blip' effects when typing and newline animation.

bloodSweatCode.chars.description: Overlay the last key/character label with the effects.

bloodSweatCode.shake.description: Approximate editor 'shake' by jittering effect decorations.

bloodSweatCode.shakeAmplitude.description: Shake amplitude in pixels (uniform in all directions).

bloodSweatCode.shakeDecayMs.description: How long (ms) shake continues after the last keypress.

bloodSweatCode.sound.description: Play sounds (your mp3 clips in media/sound).

bloodSweatCode.fireworks.description: Celebrate milestones (daily goal, every 1000 keystrokes, easter eggs) with fireworks in the sidebar.

bloodSweatCode.enableStatusBar.description: Show today's sweat, blood and code in the status bar.

bloodSweatCode.reducedEffects.description: Calm mode: no effects and no sound. Your stats still count.

bloodSweatCode.combo.maxTrail.description: Maximum number of trailing decorations to keep per effect type.

bloodSweatCode.combo.ttl.blipMs.description: Lifetime (ms) of a blip trail decoration.

bloodSweatCode.combo.ttl.boomMs.description: Lifetime (ms) of a boom trail decoration.

bloodSweatCode.combo.ttl.newlineMs.description: Lifetime (ms) of a newline trail decoration.

bloodSweatCode.combo.anim.frameMs.description: Animation frame interval in milliseconds for trail updates.

bloodSweatCode.combo.anim.floatEm.description: Additional vertical float distance (in em) over lifetime.

bloodSweatCode.combo.anim.scaleAdd.description: Additional scale amount added over lifetime.

bloodSweatCode.dailyGoalLines.description: Lines of code to write per day. Hitting it triggers a celebration.
